title: claude-markitdown-hook: honest document ingestion for AI coding assistants
description:
A Claude Code plugin for cheap, honest document ingestion. It converts referenced PDFs and Office files to markdown and hands the assistant a pointer rather than the raw contents, avoiding the substantial token cost of rendering document pages as images.

Its distinguishing behaviour is failure honesty. The underlying converter exits with a success code even when it extracts nothing — the common case for scanned documents that are images rather than text — which means a naive integration will present an empty document to the model as though conversion had succeeded. The hook detects near-empty output and reports the conversion as failed, so the assistant falls back to reading the file directly rather than confidently describing a document it never received.
